title: A Songbook for the Letters
author: Beatrix Kavanagh
blurb: Orsen Almeida, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
